title: Custom Function without comment
description:
Documentation rule — custom functions whose formula contains no comment. Shared functions especially need documented contracts.

Based on the PMD rule CommentRequired — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_documentation.html#commentrequired A filter switch above the table toggles between items without and with a comment (the commented ones serve as documentation inspiration).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A reusable function with no comment forces every caller to reverse-engineer it.
rule.remediation: Add a comment block describing parameters, return value and edge cases.
